description: This source file implements a command-line utility for sending SMS messages to virtual devices (cvds) in the Android environment. It parses command-line arguments, constructs a socket connection to a modem simulator, and uses the SmsSender class to send messages.

classes.name: SmsSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending SMS messages through a socket connection to a modem simulator.
